definitions.explanation: A publication issued once a week. Used as a prefix in magazine titles and to describe the publication frequency of periodicals.

examples.japanese: {週刊|しゅうかん}{誌|し}を{読|よ}む。
この{漫画|まんが}は{週刊|しゅうかん}{連載|れんさい}されている。
{週刊|しゅうかん}{少年|しょうねん}ジャンプは{日本|にほん}で{最|もっと}も{有名|ゆうめい}な{漫画|まんが}{雑誌|ざっし}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Weekly Shonen Jump is one of the most famous manga magazines in Japan.

notes:
USAGE NOTES:
{週刊|しゅうかん} is most commonly seen as a prefix in magazine and publication titles. Many well-known Japanese publications include it in their name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {週刊|しゅうかん}{誌|し} (weekly magazine)
- {週刊|しゅうかん}{連載|れんさい} (weekly serialization)
- {週刊|しゅうかん}{少年|しょうねん}ジャンプ (Weekly Shonen Jump)
- {週刊|しゅうかん}{文春|ぶんしゅん} (Weekly Bunshun)

SIMILAR WORDS:
Compare with other publication frequencies: {月刊|げっかん} (monthly), {日刊|にっかん} (daily), {隔週|かくしゅう} (biweekly). Be careful not to confuse with the homophones {週間|しゅうかん} (week, period of one week) or {習慣|しゅうかん} (habit).
